title_en: Tangled Remake to Bring Live-Action Rapunzel and Flynn Rider to Life in 2028 With New Release Date | D23 2026
summary_en: Disney has confirmed its live-action Tangled remake now has a 2028 release date.
body_en:
Disney has confirmed its live-action Tangled remake now has a 2028 release date.
The latest in its long line of real-life reimaginings was scheduled to premiere March 31, 2028, during the company's D23 2026 presentation today. The announcement came with a first look at the film from the cast, which includes Teagan Croft as Rapunzel, Milo Manheim as Flynn Rider, and Kathryn Hahn as Mother Gothel.
The update for Disney's movie calendar won't see the film swing in for another year and a half. Other details for how it will change from the 2010 original Tangled remain to be revealed.
Here's the first look at Kathryn Hahn as Mother Gothel in the live-action Tangled remake. #D23 pic.twitter.com/hoXrCajxcC
